name: Diepe Waters
description: A South African, Afrikaans-language telenovela which takes place in and around a competitive swimming club, Die Swartmarlyne.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Swarts family is bowled over by Gys's surprise on his 66th birthday. Meghan has life-changing plans for her future. Zelda is in for the shock of her life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Henry is bowled over with the amount of work that goes into running Die Swart Marlyne as janitor. Will he be able to cope and not feel like a fraud?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The interschool swimming gala is underway. Nina and Karla meet and instantly click as friends. Sanet implies that Karla isn’t doing her best in the pool. Bybie comes to visit Meghan at her new home.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Zelda is in a bad mood because Meghan stabbed her in the back. Johan and Tshepo get off on a bad footing and Meghan stresses over tonight's family dinner.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview:
Zelda’s gift upsets Meghan. Henry fears losing his job after he accidently knocks over one of

Gys’ trophies. Gys tells Zelda to watch out.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sanet tries to kill Meghan with kindness. Nina is still unsure about joining Die Swart Marlyne and Karla tries to convince her to jump ship. Meghan finds something that Gys has been hiding from her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Bybie and Meghan finally see what’s inside the secret suitcase under Gys and Meghan’s bed. Gys finally finds the perfect physio for the Swart Marlyne. Zelda is not feeling well at all.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview:
Thsepo finds a way to solve his and Henry’s money problems. Pamela is stunned to see

Arno at Die Swart Marlyne. Sanet is given some of her own medicine.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Henry is worried about Tshepo. Pam is not looking forward to seeing Sanet again and Gys is told to stop spending so much money.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Henry warns Tshepo not to race against Johan but Tshepo is determined to put Johan in his place. Meghan comes up with a business proposal for Gys. Nina is still trying to get Johan's attention.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Zelda manipulates Arno to get any info about Gys that she can use against him. Meghan starts the social media pages for Die Swart Marlyne. Karla keeps making herself mor sick - the stress her family is putting on her is taking its toll.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Sanet is furious when Meghan tries to lighten her load and steps in as the host of the book club. Wanda thinks Meghan is the sweetest thing. Wim is frustrated with Rose who is always preoccupied.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The Swarts family is taken aback when Gys reveals his big dream. Lettie has an idea what the situation with Tshepo is. Anja’s birthday calls up painful memories.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Henry confronts Lettie about the food she’s been giving Tshepo. Meghan tries to convince Gys that she is clever enough to start her own business. Arno rats out sensitive information about Die Swart Marlyne to Zelda.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Zelda puts her plan in motion to ambush Gys. Gys is having a really bad day and Henry takes drastic measures to provide for Tshepo.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Meghan is still missing. Karla thinks she failed her entrance exams to Open View University. Nina is on cloud nine when Johan asks her to be his date for the matric ball.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Gys spoils Meghan after her accident in the hope that she will forgive him. Bybie provides Gys with an unpleasant surprise. Lettie gives Tshepo a solution to his financial problems. Nina tries to convince Karla to come to the Matric Farewell.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Bybie does the unforgivable with disastrous consequences. Henry’s beloved St Christopher goes missing. Jacques gives Meghan invaluable advice in order to convince Gys to support her business venture.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Gys wants Bybie out of his house, Tshepo doesn’t want to wear Henry’s mafia suit to the matric dance and Nina wonders how she will get out of a crisis.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: When Nina doesn’t have a dress for the matric dance, Karla comes to the rescue. Bybie helps set up for the pre-drinks party and lends a helping hand to Tshepo. Meghan has a plan to wow Yolandi.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The results of Karla’s entrance exam are revealed. Zelda has a clever plan to milk Gys for more money. Lydia confronts Sanet about her drinking.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Rossouw and his family struggle to come to terms with Lydia’s prognosis, Zelda pitches to Donovan and Sanet must call her sister.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sanet promises to stop drinking if her mother lives. Pam tells Zelda that she wants to start online tutorials. At the charity event Zelda discovers that Gys and Donovan are friends.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Karla gets a surprise while keeping watch over Lydia in hospital. Meghan pitches her skincare range to Gys. Sanet hears from Anja, but has to wait longer to see her. Henry is prepping frantically for the lunch with Meghan, Jacques and Gys.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Lydia sees Anja for the first time in 20 years. Gys has managed to secure a loan for Meghan's start-up business. Lettie wants to find Henry's St Christopher.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Anja struggles to see Sanet and Rossouw together. Sanet tries to convince Anja to go back to Kenya. Rossouw gives Anja a reason to stay longer. Lettie gives Henry the wrong St Christopher.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Sanet is upset when she hears that Rossouw invited Anja to stay longer. Zelda finds out who got the contract from Donovan. Bybie doesn’t like the makeover Pam did on her.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Someone discovers Zelda’s secret about her illness. Sanet wants to emigrate immediately and Nina gets back at Johan.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Zelda admits to Arno that she will have to come up with a good reason why she will not be at the salon during her chemo sessions. Anja organizes a burger night for the family. Henry insists on paying Lettie back for his grandma's necklace.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Lydia’s health deteriorates and she asks to see Anja, which upsets Sanet. Henry finds his missing purse and Tshepo believes his luck has turned. Sanet believes Rossouw prefers Anja above her. Lydia dies.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Sanet organises Lydia’s funeral. Johan and Karla struggle to come to terms with Ouma’s death. Anja’s true feelings about Lydia surface. Henry tests if his luck has turned.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Henry is convinced his luck has turned. Rossouw confronts Anja about leaving him and Gys expects too much from Meghan.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: The community pays their respects to Sanet and her family at Lydia’s funeral. Lydia is remembered as a very honourable, loyal and kind person. Anja finds it hard to mourn her mother. Henry’s gambling becomes a problem.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Sanet shares everything about her past with her father. Anja suspects that Karla may have emotional issues. Lettie pulls out all the stops to control Henry's gambling addiction.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Leon causes more trouble between Sanet and Anja. Tension between the two grandfathers leads to a fist fight. The embarrassment is too much for Karla.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Karla’s loneliness threatens to swallow her whole. Tshepo and Nina form a new bond, while Anja wrestles with her murky memories in the swimming pool.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: A deep conversation between Leon and Anja leads to a warning regarding Sanet. A dinner causes trouble between Gys and Meghan. Nina takes a stand against Johan.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: To build a relationship is more difficult than butterfly stroke. Finances cause headaches, and a dark secret almost sees the light.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Lydia’s will is read, and a special letter causes someone to see red. Gys and the competitive coach Frederich know just how to push each other’s buttons.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Tension runs high in Rossouw’s household, Gys is embarrassed in public and two people experience an unexpected moment…

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: A social media post spreads like wildfire. Henry tests out Jacques’ tips for his heart, and Johan’s anger boils over.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Zelda revels in Gys’s troubles, and Johan pushes his body too far. Henry tries to win back Lettie, and Anja is concerned about Rossouw.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Steroids might be the answer to a question, while Anja asks Rossouw about Sanet’s secret. Megan receives good news about her business, and a relationship is in jeopordy.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Gys wonders about the decisions he has made in the last few months, and Johan is frustrated with his situation. Anja needs to have a conversation with Sanet regarding Karla.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Gys gives Meghan the inconvenient truth, and Jacques understands Henry's complicated relationship. Johan takes the bull by the horns with a needle.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Johan feels like a new person, and tongues are wagging because of a headscarf. Gys shares some good news with the family.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Jacques wants to help Henry conquer his fears, while Pam wants to take care of Zelda. Rossouw and Sanet reach another hurdle in their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Pam feels insecure about her relationship with Zelda, Wim doesn’t know how to start a difficult discussion with Rose. There is huge drama at the Christmas party.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Drug tests make the swimmers uneasy. Sanet places Karla’s problems at her own door. Bybie’s good intentions only disrupt Meghan’s plans.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Bybie tries to twist Braam's arm. Sanet and Rossouw need to have a serious conversation with Karla. Pam and Zelda's relationship hits another hurdle. Arno entices Johan towards the deep end...

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Karla blames herself for Sanet’s shortcomings, and Nina makes an uncomfortable discovery. Gys asks Ansie a huge favor in regards to Braam’s property.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Family problems bring Anja and Rossouw closer, while Sanet wants to know who stole her money. Bybie stuns Meghan when she thinks she knows what to do about Pam and Zelda.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: The Rossouw’s receive a new - and intriguing - guest. Zelda makes a plan with Johan. Wim and Rose need to have an awkward conversation with Tshepo and Nina.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Rossouw feels threatened by Farooq’s presence. Karla and Sanet’s conversation leads to promises. Pam and Zelda’s swords cross even louder.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Farooq and Rossouw have a confrontation regarding Anja. Johan’s paranoia increases, while Jacques takes Karla under his wing.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Farooq and Anja share big news with the family. Pam opens up to Jacques about her struggles. Zelda keeps Johan in line with her plan.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Johan is back in action. Rossouw struggles to come to terms with Anja’s announcement, and Pam is trying her best to impress Gys.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Anja gets very upset when she sees how Gys treats Karla. Pam’s carelessness irritates Zelda, and Sanet plays open cards with Jacques.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Anja and Rossouw are confronted - and then Sanet makes a drastic decision. Bybie wants to prescribe forgiveness after her discovery, while aggression becomes a serious problem.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Unpredictable behaviour leads to a nasty confrontation. Zelda tries to extend an olive branch to Pam, while a very necessary discussion becomes scorching hot.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Rossouw and Anja make a big decision, while Johan does something to protect his privacy. Pam gives Zelda an ultimatum, and Gys gets the shock of his life!

videos.overview: Gys is searching for words to break the news, and Pam is tired of waiting: she is looking for answers from Zelda. Jacques reaches out to Anja, and Tommy makes a discovery.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Karla picks up on the tension between her parents, and makes a shocking announcement. Pam and Zelda have to dig deep for information, and Meghan has a plan to bring in money.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Johan’s matric results shift his focus to Nina - and it is all but healthy. Jacques tries to find proof for a suspicion, while Nina tries to support Karla during a difficult day.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Arno has struggles of his own to overcome, while Nina swears Tshepo to silence. Meghan is trying to get information from Anja about Gys, and there is tension between swimmers.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Wim and Rose are worried about Nina. Rossouw asks Anja for help. Tshepo can’t bite his tongue any longer. Anja opens up to Karla.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Sanet is not happy with Karla’s ultimatum. Pam gets cold feet after new information comes to light, and Lettie gives Henry advice on what should happen next.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Karla’s new coach causes problems, and Henry’s favour leads to a serious conversation between Arno and Johan. Lettie and Nomsa assist Pam with her preparation.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Meghan meets Deedee’s ex-husband, and Anja is not happy with Rossouw’s actions. Pam gets the courage for a cup of tea, and Gys manipulates Sanet.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Meghan’s hard work can be derailed by Gys, and Sanet tries hard to save her relationship with Rossouw. Zelda is very happy with her plan…

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Rossouw and Anja have to work together to curb Karla’s anxiety, while Gys takes his frustrations out on Johan. Sanet receives advice, while Nina asks Wim for a favour.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Meghan wants to know who Gys really is. Rossouw is not the only one in a mood. Arno’s dark dealings lead him to seek out an escape - and it leads to a huge fight.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Silence makes a decision at a crossroad easier, while Sanet seeks advice from Jacques. Lettie has a new challenge for Henry, while Christelle shares shocking news with Johan.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Sanet embarrasses Meghan, and Rossouw finds himself in hell. A DNA test leads to a meeting. Christelle is desperate to prove the truth.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Christelle takes drastic steps, while Johan’s discovery leads him deeper into the darkness. Karla and Nina have a huge fight, and Henry upsets Lettie’s plan.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Anja warns Rossouw against Christelle, while Sanet tries to intimidate her. It is the day of the big gala, and Gys and Zelda take each other on.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Pam has a new search on her hands, while Rossouw puts Sanet and Johan in their place. Lettie gives Tshepo a great idea, and Gys confronts Frederich about an idea.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Johan reaches out to Christelle - and must act quickly when officials arrive to test the swimmers. Meghan’s idea stuns Gys, and Lettie shares harsh words.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: The test results send shockwaves through the community, and Lettie takes Sanet to task. The truth hurts, while Gys takes on his business decision with great vigour.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Karla makes a shocking discovery, while a tombstone causes trouble. An angry Pam confronts Zelda. Sanet receives support from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Lydia’s letter opens old wounds, while Meghan and Jacques’ friendship deepens. Pam and Zelda are both stubborn, and Johan overplays his hand.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Rose discusses her strategy with Henry and Tshepo. Anja has to face her past head on, while Johan’s nerves (regarding the tests) reach breaking point.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Jacques reveals the results of the drug tests, and Frederich shares exciting news with Gys. Tshepo shares information with Rose. Anja tries to support Rossouw.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Henry confronts Rossouw, and Nina tries to cheer up Tshepo. Sanet storms out of the house after a fight with Johan, while Rose takes on Gys.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Rossouw explodes over Gys’ selfishness. Sanet is fishing for information from Wim. Henry is anxious about Tshepo’s decision, and Johan doesn’t sail into dark waters alone.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Zelda gives Jacques a stern warning, and Laura James might be the answer to prayers. The result of the paternity test has huge consequences.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Tshepo’s hearing makes everyone nervous. Christelle needs to explain her decision. Arno thinks Zelda still has a trump card. Deedee makes a shocking decision.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Tshepo makes a decision about his future, and a guest at Meghan’s party causes havoc. Friedrich shares interesting news with Gys, and a kiss is very unexpected.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: A big secret is revealed, while Tshepo and Nina’s friendship hits troubled waters. Sanet tries to remain positive about Johan, and Rossouw wonders about Gys.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Sanet is livid because of Rossouw’s decision - but it isn’t the only life-changing decision he is contemplating. Meghan’s head is not just full of ‘cruel’ plans.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Gys and Wim have advice for Sanet regarding Rossouw, while Johan feels the heat. Meghan remembers her mother’s last words - and her heart (and hands) speak louder.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Rossouw wants to take the bull by the horns. Gys has an enormous crisis on hand, and Zelda has a new task for Arno. Karla’s friends leave her speechless.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Gys has big plans to save the club after the scandal. Rossouw is more than ready to take the next step, and Sanet gets unexpected support.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Rossouw’s household needs to deal with the aftermath of the press conference, while Sanet’s olive branch is met with suspicion. Jacques tries to set boundaries with his heart.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Rossouw has to think fast on his feet, while Johan’s decision sends shockwaves through the community. Pam takes a chance on love, and Anja struggles with her conscience.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Bybie is convinced that she knows what is going on with Jacques. Johan begins his first day of his new life, and Sanet is suspicious of Karla.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Pam has big plans for Jacques, but Zelda is not having it. Jacques will have to play dirty to broker peace. Rossouw is in trouble…

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Rose learns of a new friendship. There is a huge surprise for Pam at Jacques’ house, and Bybie is sworn to silence. Sanet offers to help Wim with his crisis.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Pam can’t control her tongue, and Friedrich tries to help Johan. Karla sees something that she is definitely not supposed to, and Wim is frustrated with Rose.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Zelda wants to ensure that Bybie keeps her secret, and Karla struggles to make sense of what she saw. Sanet’s AA-meeting delivers a surprise.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Friedrich realises the cost of Johan’s trauma, and Karla makes a surprising move. Wim and Rose are at loggerheads, while Jacques’ conscience is bothering him.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: The wind is taken from Karla’s sails when Sanet shares his big plan with her. Zelda shows her nails to more than one person, and Rose talks to Laura about work.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: A photo gives Karla nightmares, and Wim receives a shocking call. Bybie tries to warn Meghan before her departure, and Friedrich has a different coaching style to Gys.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Lettie gives Pam an ultimatum, and Wim’s honesty gives Rose a headache. Sanet’s big night takes more than one dramatic turn.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: The big reveal of the night is not the only secret that is brought to the surface. In light of all the secrets, Jacques has to think about his own secret.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: The Swarts family are still trying to pick up the pieces after the big revelation, while Sanet makes it clear she won’t make it easy to conquer the future.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Johan’s expulsion is over and he is excited to start at Frederich’s. Rossouw and Gys have a very nasty confrontation, and Sanet is losing control.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Arno is rattled when he needs to save someone’s life. Anja needs to help Sanet out of a difficult situation. The Swarts family is upset about Karla’s accident.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Everyone feels guilty for their part in Karla’s situation. Meghan doesn’t know how much longer she can play the game, and Sanet is busy losing it completely.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Sanet and Rossouw’s appointment with Karla’s doctor doesn’t go as planned. Rose is not happy with Wim’s friendship, and Tshepo feels the pressure.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Rossouw and Sanet’s fights are getting ugly. Gys mounts pressure on Nina and Tshepo, while Johan is living his best life under Friedrich’s guidance.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: The big day of the regionals are here, and there are a few surprising twists that take place in the swimming pool. Tshepo and Nina are feeling the heat.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Gys has a bad day, and Sanet confronts Rossouw about the envelope that she receives. Johan makes his decision, while an excuse doesn’t go down well.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Jacques takes Rossouw to task because he isn’t supporting Sanet. Nina’s shock leads to new disclosures. Zelda is not impressed with Meghan’s viewpoint.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Wim and Rose devise a plan after Nina’s disclosure. Meghan’s Gush party is in full swing. Gys is nervous to eventually meet his secret investor.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Gys gets angry as Zelda confronts him. Wim is looking for Johan, and things take a turn for the worse at the party.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: A medical condition shocks the Swarts family, and Rossouw and Sanet are informed about what is going on. Lettie has to save Henry from his new status.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Rossouw and Jacques have to think fast when an unexpected investor announces they are also part owner of the club. Lettie’s past comes back to haunt her.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Tshepo convinces Tommie to take action: love doesn’t wait for anyone. Kurt’s investigation brings him closer to the truth.

videos.overview: Karla is shocked to see Anja coaching at the club. Henry is anxious that Kurt might suspect him of being the guilty one. Zelda catches Sanet off guard.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Henry gets jealous, while Karla tries to convince Sanet to get help. Nina has something to tell her parents. Kurt’s investigation is ruffling feathers.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Sanet asks Karla to keep quiet about the accident. Rose realises that she is working on a case that might have an impact on Tshepo. Johan comes between Anja and Rossouw.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Meghan is questioned by Kurt – and gets shocking news. Zelda tries to throw her weight around at the Swartmarlyne. Kurt questions Jacques about Meghan.

videos.overview: Rose struggles to adjust to her new work. Sanet’s relationship with the bottle drives Karla to breaking point. Kurt gets information from interesting candidates.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Zelda unexpectedly shares a shocking secret. Rossouw and Anja discuss Gys and Sanet, while Gys’ memory is something to be concerned about.

videos.overview: Anja and the family are surprised by a family member’s arrival. Pam takes care of Gys and Gys takes unexpected steps. Both Gys and Sanet feel a bit lost.

videos.overview: Leon asks Sanet to go to Kenya, and Sanet questions Kurt. Henry has a question for Lettie, while Nina asks Karla about Arno. Kurt thinks he knows who is guilty.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Anja encourages Rossouw to go to Gys’ gathering without her, while Henry tries to handle his broken heart. Gys’ memory wants to shine a light on the subject.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: The truth about the attack on Gys is revealed. Jacques and Meghan can’t ignore each other anymore, and Wim tries to assist Henry with his romantic challenges.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Johan needs to make a difficult decision to ensure his future. Meghan wants to take the next step in her relationship. Bybie hears about Gys’ questions…

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Gys is on a mission to find out the truth – and Bybie catches him in his endeavour! Meghan is restless at the Swarts house. Lettie has a special request for Henry.

videos.overview: Zelda calls Arno to come and help her with a crisis. Henry plans something special for Lettie. Nina suggests that Tshepo tries to find his family.

videos.overview: Henry wants to do something special and asks around for advice. Zelda’s past catches up with her and Pam is shocked by a revelation that will change her life.

videos.overview: Anja and Rossouw take charge of the party. Nina and Tshepo jump in to help a nervous Henry, and Rossouw struggles to accept Gys’ revelation.

videos.overview: Rossouw is livid regarding the new ‘crisis’. Meghan struggles with her past and Zelda’s part in it, while Karla tries to impress Arno.

videos.overview: Meghan is determined to better understand her past. Zelda puts Gys under more strain, and Tommie has big plans for him and Karla’s performance.

videos.overview: Meghan confronts Zelda and Bybie about her past. The National Championships delivers huge drama!

videos.overview: Meghan remembers more about the day of the accident, and Gys tries to make up for lost time – while his behaviour irritates Jacques. Tshepo is noticed…

videos.overview: Voices from the past upset Jacques – and makes Gys see red. Rossouw and Pam are not sitting around the same fire, while Tshepo is caugh off guard by a visitor.

videos.overview: Jacques’ truth cuts Gys deeply. Henry and Tshepo fight over Masinya. Karl feels guilty about her relationship with Anja. Meghan makes a big decision.

videos.overview: Sanet’s return causes tension, and Rossouw finds new evidence about the fraud that shocks Pam. Karla pulls more strings to impress Arno.

videos.overview: Parm’s heartache could be a way for Zelda to win her back. Henry is concerned about Masinya’s intentions. Sanet wants to help Tommie and Karla.

videos.overview: Martha and Masinya argue about Tshepo, while Sanet is ready to talk about divorce. An interaction with Zelda makes Pam run straight to Gys.

videos.overview: Pam is shocked in both Gys and Zelda’s behavior. Henry’s concerns regarding Masinya grows, and Sanet worms her way into the talent show.
